description: servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. Coverage: the area served by servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. The listing groups 28 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Emergenza alluvione FIUMI 2024 - DTM APC FIUMI 2024; Emergenza alluvione 2023 maggio - rilievo con DRONI - Rilievo DRONE. C; Emergenza alluvione 2023 maggio - Immagine satellitari Planet maggio 2; Emergenza alluvione 2024 settembre - Perimetrazione delle aree allagat. Formats seen: WMS, WCS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
